All-New 2028 BMW M6 Neue Klasse Takes the Fifth-Gen 6 Series Back in Time to the E24 Age – Rendering
8 photos
Photo: mike.g.concepts / Instagram
According to the rumor mill, BMW’s upcoming first-ever M3 Electric will pack 838 horsepower and might live up to the badge after the first media drives with camouflaged prototypes. But, of course, many folks won’t have eyes for anything other than an ICE-based M GmbH model.
No worries, as there will be something for everyone. Also, according to the rumor mill, the premium Bavarian automaker from Germany has no less than ten fresh models coming in 2027: an i1 entry-level electric car, the X1 and iX1 compact CUVs, refreshed X2 and iX2, the i3 Touring, the electric M3 and X3 plus iX4, the facelifted 5 Series, as well as the flagship X7 and first iX7 along with the new BMW Alpina rivaling Maybach’s goodies.
As you can see, although there are a ton of novelties, there are no surprises – models that we haven’t heard about just yet. No worries, the rumor mill will take care of that – with help from a member of the imaginative guild of digital car content creators who stopped dwelling across the parallel universes of vehicular CGI to address the BMW situation.
More precisely, Mike G., the leader of the ' mike.g.concepts ' design studio, "fueled by adrenaline and innovation," has decided to bring back to CGI life the BMW M6 performance grand tourer. The original BMW 6 Series was introduced as the E24 back during the late 1970s, just after the company concluded the original Neue Klasse models.
The BMW 6 Series went on hiatus after 1989 and was revived in 2003 with the E63/E64 models, followed by the F06/F12/F13, and concluded with the G32 fourth generation back in 2023, featuring only a five-door fastback body style. Now, the virtual artist wants to use the modern Neue Klasse strategy as an impulse to revive the 6 Series once more, albeit with a decidedly retro-modern look paying tribute to the original E24. Even better, he’s directly thinking about the high-performance BMW M6 version in his latest unofficial, hypothetical design project.
Styled as a true grand tourer, this BMW M6 coupe has a design that mixes the fresh Neue Klasse with the lines of the “timeless BMW 635,” reviving the signature ‘shark nose.’ “Beyond these inspirations, this concept embodies my own ideal of an M6: unapologetically edgy and aggressively muscular, truly living up to the ‘M’ badge,” adds the pixel master.
Also, the CGI expert didn’t just envision the exterior design; he also created a retro-modern cockpit with a single digital screen acting as the instrument cluster and imagined his BMW M6 concept with something brawny under the hood: BMW’s beloved 4.4-liter twin-turbo V8, tuned for grand touring duties with 575 hp and 680 Nm (502 lb-ft) of torque. Cool, right? View this post on Instagram A post shared by Mike G. (@mike.g.concepts)
